sampleNote: row-level holdout from a register the model trains on; in-domain, not comparable to scores.json

spellability.rule: Male Latin has no w or x, and uses c only in the digraph ch

note: Scored per direction, never as one mixed average: both directions come from one set of weights and a mixed number can hide one that has collapsed. If directionsBelowSizeFloor is non-empty these scores are indicative only and must not be published as results (R-8.9, NFR-8).
